installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Install the Scalbox fork of Pterodactyl Exporter.
set -euo pipefail

apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl git

mkdir -p /mnt/server/.python
cd /mnt/server

# Upgrade the exporter code and dependencies directly from the Scalbox fork.
python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check --no-cache-dir --upgrade \
    --target /mnt/server/.python \
    "git+https://github.com/scalbox/pterodactyl_exporter.git@main"

# Preserve an existing, user-customized configuration.
if [ ! -f /mnt/server/config.yml ]; then
    curl -fsSL \
        https://raw.githubusercontent.com/scalbox/pterodactyl_exporter/main/config.example.yml \
        -o /mnt/server/config.yml
fi

echo "Scalbox Pterodactyl Exporter installation complete!"

variables.name: Hostname
variables.description: The host name of the Pterodactyl Panel instance to be monitored

variables.name: Listen Address
variables.description: IP address the exporter binds to inside the container. Keep 0.0.0.0 for Prometheus access through the Pterodactyl allocation. Use a valid IPv4 or IPv6 address.

variables.name: API Key
variables.description: The client API key of your Panel instance

variables.name: HTTPS
variables.description: Enable or disable the use of HTTPS.

variables.name: Ignore SSL
variables.description: Ignore the validity of the Panel's SSL cert. Not used if HTTPS is turned off.

variables.name: Server List Type
variables.description: Define the way how the server list is read.

variables.name: Query Interval
variables.description: Define the time between queries of the Panel API

variables.name: Panel Port (optional)
variables.description: Optional port of the Pterodactyl Panel API, not the exporter listening port (which uses the server allocation).

variables.name: Include Servers (UUIDs)
variables.description: Optional full server UUIDs separated by commas, spaces or newlines. Empty = all servers accessible to the API key (except exclusions).

variables.name: Exclude Servers (UUIDs)
variables.description: Optional full server UUIDs separated by commas, spaces or newlines. These servers are excluded even if also included.
